name: table-25
description: Clickable rows that open the selected customer's details below the table.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" const customers = [ { id: "c1", name: "Sara Khan", plan: "Pro", seats: 12, since: "2023" }, { id: "c2", name: "Omar Ali", plan: "Team", seats: 48, since: "2021" }, { id: "c3", name: "Priya Shah", plan: "Starter", seats: 3, since: "2025" }, ] export default function ClickableRowsDetailTable() { const [activeId, setActiveId] = React.useState("c2") const active = customers.find((c) => c.id === activeId)! return (
Customer Plan Seats {customers.map((c) => ( setActiveId(c.id)} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && setActiveId(c.id)} > {c.name} {c.plan} {c.seats} ))}
{active.name .split(" ") .map((n) => n[0]) .join("")}

{active.name}

{active.plan} plan · {active.seats} seats · customer since{" "} {active.since}

) }
